caption: Agent Configuration Declaration
description: The declared half of an AI agent's trust base: the model and the digest-anchored artifacts (adapters, tool schemas, policy bundles) the agent is configured to run, as asserted by its registry, manifest, or control plane — before any drift introduced at load or execution time. For an API-hosted model with no locally loadable artifact, the pinned ai_model tuple (provider, name, version) is the trust-base element and no artifact digest is expected; digests apply exactly where bytes are locally loaded.
name: agent_config_declaration

ai_model.description: The model the agent is declared to run, as pinned by its configuration.

artifacts.description: The digest-anchored artifacts the agent is declared to load: adapters, tool schemas, policy bundles, model weights. Digests are those asserted by the registry or manifest the declaration was read from.
